patch.summary: Switch a collection on or off for the knowledge graph, set its vocabulary
patch.description: Package 6.2, administrator only, never an agent grant. JSON body with active, vocabulary and/or llm (package 6.3: the LLM enrichment, scoutro.kg.llm.collections); unknown fields are refused. Only this collection's keys change, with their existing meaning: scoutro.kg.collections (the name added or removed, the other names as they are; * stays *), scoutro.kg.collections.inactive (switched off: not followed, also under *; the reconcile deletes nothing of it and nothing new is extracted from it; a page deleted from the index still leaves the graph) and scoutro.kg.vocab.<collection>. A change takes effect at once: the running graph is reopened with the new settings (a manual pause stays), and the reconcile of every start reads the pages a collection switched on already has in the index (the existing backfill). No schema change, no deletion, no new collection. 400 collection_id_invalid, 400 collection_reserved (robot_*), 400 vocabulary_unknown, 400 invalid_request, 404 collection_unknown (neither in the catalog nor named by the graph), 409 operation_running while a backup, restore or rebuild runs (nothing written), 409 llm_all_collections (nothing written). Also accepts independent jobsExtraction, jobsDisplay and jobsMatching; initial legacy opt-ins are frozen before the first policy change. Only extraction changes require re-extraction.

post.summary: Move one domain's pages between collections
post.description: Administrator only, JSON body of at most 4 KiB (413 payload_too_large), same origin. Without confirm a preview: the hosts of the domain, how many pages, the collections before and after, a sample and a token; nothing changes. With confirm set to that token it changes collection_sxt of exactly those pages (and their webgraph edges) by a Solr atomic update with the version of the preview: text, JSON-LD and every other field stay, nothing is crawled, deleted or re-indexed, and the knowledge graph takes the new collections over through its sync (re-scoped; tiers 1 and 2 extracted again only if the extractors changed; LLM evidence is neither asked again nor corrected). A page whose version changed since (a new crawl) is never overwritten; a webgraph edge gets its page's collections only once the page has them (webgraphKept counts the others). Only the domain's pages in a removed collection move (without remove: every page of the domain); other collections stay. 400 invalid_request (domain not one registrable domain, add and remove both empty or overlapping, unknown field), 400 collection_unknown, 409 reassign_preview_stale (the pages changed since the preview; details hold the new preview), 409 host_busy (a crawl of the domain runs), 422 reassign_would_empty (a page would keep no collection), 422 reassign_too_large (more than 5000 pages or 100000 webgraph edges), 503 index_unavailable. A later crawl of the domain writes the collection of that crawl again; Discovery refuses such a crawl while the domain has pages in another collection (collection_conflict), and 'scoutro-discovery exclude' takes the domain out of the wrong profile. Agents cannot use it.

upgrade.description: The last schema migration of this graph (current schema 5 with durable observations); null if it was never upgraded. Before it: PRAGMA quick_check (a failed or unfinished check keeps the graph off, state unavailable, reason upgrade_blocked, file unchanged) and a verified copy graph-<UTC>-before-upgrade.db. Without room for the copy the additive migration still runs, but re-extraction with the current extractors waits (waiting) until a verified backup exists.

backup.description: With action restore or delete_backup only: the backup file, by its name of GET /kg/backups; never a path.

action.description: pause stops new growth (stored across restarts); deletions, state changes and bookkeeping continue. resume ends a manual pause, schedules a full reconcile and, after a storage error or a failed or aborted integrity check, requests a new PRAGMA quick_check; graph writes resume only when it passes (store.integrity). reconcile schedules a full reconcile now. confirm_reconcile lets a reconcile that the mass-deletion brake stopped (sync.reconcile.awaitingConfirmation) delete the documents it confirmed as absent; 409 nothing_to_confirm otherwise. llm_retry makes the documents the LLM tier gave up on due again and closes its circuit breaker (the answer adds reopened); 409 llm_unavailable while the tier is off. backup writes a verified copy into DATA/SCOUTRO/knowledge/backup on the backup thread (status backup.state, backup.last; skipped with the guard's reason while growth is paused or the budget or disk reserve would be crossed). restore (with backup: a file name of GET /kg/backups) checks the backup (SHA-256 of its metadata, quick_check, schema version), stops the graph, keeps the current database as graph-<UTC>-before-restore.db, puts exactly the chosen backup and its history in place with a new dataset epoch, without mixing newer observations, and starts the graph again, which reconciles with Solr; 404 backup_not_found, 422 backup_invalid (nothing changed), 409 operation_running, 503 restore_failed (the previous graph is back). rebuild re-resolves every identity and extracts every page again with the current vocabulary (brake, cancel and progress, the old graph serves until the swap): it builds a shadow graph from Solr in DATA/SCOUTRO/knowledge/rebuild with the current rules (live facts are extracted from current sources; durable observations, corrections and current classifications are carried after the old writer stops) while the graph keeps serving, verifies it (quick_check, the reconcile's mass-deletion brake), keeps the current database as graph-<UTC>-before-rebuild.db, redirects entity IDs the new graph does not know, and swaps it in with a new dataset epoch; progress in rebuild. 409 operation_running (details.reason reconcile_busy while a reconcile waits for its confirmation or a reset runs), 503 kg_write_refused with reason rebuild_space when the budget has no room for the shadow. rebuild_cancel deletes the shadow before the swap; the graph stays as it is. rebuild_confirm lets a rebuild that the brake stopped (rebuild.awaitingConfirmation) swap. 409 no_rebuild otherwise. derive makes the derived layer (weak links, same operator, suggested matches; no facts) due at the next maintenance step instead of after scoutro.kg.derived.intervalMinutes; it still waits for the sync, a rebuild and every growth refusal (status derived). 409 derived_unavailable while scoutro.kg.derived.enabled=false. delete_backup (with backup, package 6.3) deletes one backup and its metadata file: only a name of GET /kg/backups, the file a regular file directly in DATA/SCOUTRO/knowledge/backup (no symbolic link), never the graph's own graph.db, WAL or SHM; the answer is the status with deleted and the backup state after it. 400 for anything but such a name, 404 backup_not_found, 409 operation_running while a backup, restore or rebuild swap holds the backup slot (nothing deleted), 503 backup_delete_failed. Restore and download of the other backups are unchanged.

name.description: Display name (the given name of a created collection, else the id).

documents.description: Pages of it in the index (0 for a created collection without pages; null: unknown).

selectable.description: Offered in every collection choice. Equal to chat, knowledgeGraph and crawlTarget: one definition for all uses.

graph.description: Administrator only: the knowledge graph's view of the collection (as in kg/status.collections); null when the graph does not know it or is off.

add.description: Collections every moved page gets; existing, selectable ones only.

remove.description: Collections to take away; only the domain's pages in one of them are moved (without remove: every page of the domain). Other collections of a page stay.

confirm.description: The token of the preview to apply; without it the request is only a preview and changes nothing.

collection.description: System index/SEO scope; intersected with authorized collections.

content.description: Text or OpenAI content parts. Only latest user text selects a system action.

agentBearer.description: Agent token issued in Administration > Agents & Access. Only valid on /scoutro/api/agent/v1/*; never an administrator credential. Also accepted by root /v1/chat/completions for structured system questions only, with the same selected action authorization.
